title: UMAP 0.6 adds recursive init, new optimizers, faster search
summary: UMAP 0.6 is released with a recursive initialization scheme, new optimizers using hard-negative mining, and nearest-neighbor search the maintainer says is about 4x faster through better use of PyNNDescent. The maintainer reports that on 3 million arXiv papers a full run finishes in under 5 minutes with the new optimizers, versus 52 minutes for a seeded UMAP 0.5 run that was single-threaded, and that seeded 0.6 runs are reproducible while using all cores. The new initialization and optimizers are said to improve million-scale cluster detail, but they are opt-in via compatibility\_layout=False because they change the output; future versions are planned to make them default.
